The sound has a short spectral bandwidth and clear impact. Music continues as a steady background bed without interruption. The BGM volume is slightly lowered in the mix to allow these environmental cues to be heard clearly. (4) Vocals: High-energy dialogue continues as the group arrives at a cafe. SFX: A crisp, percussive splash sound of liquid being poured into a glass. Ambient: A dense layer of moderate cafe chatter from a restaurant patio and the occasional high-pitched clink of ceramic dishes and silverware. (5) Vocals: Enthusiastic vocalizations including a loud "Bravo" with high emotional arousal and positive valence. SFX: Subtle rustling sounds of clothing and movement. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and style, providing a rhythmic foundation for the conversation. (6) SFX: A repeating sequence of mechanical sliding and heavy thudding sounds as the van door is operated multiple times during the arrivals and departures. These transient events trigger clear shifts in the acoustic atmosphere from outdoor street noise to a quieter vehicle interior. (7) Vocals: Casual, high-arousal conversation while walking outdoors. (8) SFX: Rhythmic, high-frequency rustling of paper and plastic shopping bags as the group walks through the shopping district. The sounds are sharp and well-defined in the mix. Music volume swells slightly during transitions between locations. (9) Vocals: A calm, satisfied concluding speech delivered at night with moderate conversational loudness.
